units.source_text: 此外又有许多古人之作，有的吟咏好容易等到了早莺初啭的声音而悲喜交集之情，

en.t: There were also many poems by people of old; some sang of the mingled sorrow and joy of finally hearing the first notes of the early warbler,

units.source_text: 有的是古歌：“家住冈边梅盛放，春来不乏早莺声。”都是转悲为喜时率书自慰的。

en.t: and one was an old poem: "My home is by the hill, where the plum blossoms are in full bloom; when spring comes, the early warbler's song is never lacking." All of these had been dashed off to comfort herself when sorrow turned into joy.

units.source_text: 源氏一一取来阅读，脸上显出微笑，其神情优美动人。

en.t: Genji took them up one by one and read them, a smile appearing on his face; his expression was graceful and deeply charming.

units.source_text: 他提起笔来，也想写些，此时明石姬膝行而出了。

en.t: He picked up his brush, intending to write something too, when the Lady of Akashi came out, moving forward on her knees.

units.source_text: 她对源氏，态度当然十分恭谨，相见时彬彬有礼。

en.t: Toward Genji, of course, her manner was extremely respectful, and when they met she was refined and courteous.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得此人毕竟与众不同。

en.t: Genji felt that she was, after all, unlike ordinary women.

units.source_text: 她身穿源氏所赠的白色中国式礼服。

en.t: She was wearing the white Chinese-style formal robe that Genji had given her.

units.source_text: 鲜艳的黑发披在这衣服上，虽然略觉稀薄，反而增添美趣，令人爱煞。

en.t: Her glossy black hair fell over the robe; though it seemed a little thin, this only added to her beauty and made her all the more lovable.

units.source_text: 源氏也想到：今天是新年元旦，若不回家，深恐紫姬怨恨。

en.t: Genji also thought that since today was New Year's Day, if he did not return home, Lady Murasaki would surely resent him deeply.

units.source_text: 然而他终于在明石姬家住宿了。

en.t: Even so, in the end he spent the night at the Lady of Akashi's residence.

units.source_text: 各女眷闻此消息，知道明石姬特别承宠，大家对她心怀醋意。

en.t: When the other ladies heard the news and realized that the Lady of Akashi was especially favored, they all felt jealous of her.

units.source_text: 春殿里的人更不必说了。

en.t: Needless to say, this was even more true of those in the Spring Palace.

units.source_text: 天色将曙之时，源氏便告辞归去。

en.t: As dawn was about to break, Genji took his leave and returned home.

units.source_text: 别后明石姬回想他深夜辜负香衾，常觉可悲可惜。

en.t: After they parted, the Lady of Akashi often thought sadly and regretfully of how he had left the fragrant bedclothes unused in the deep night.

units.source_text: 紫姬等得心焦，满怀妬恨。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had waited in anxious distress, her heart filled with jealousy and resentment.

units.source_text: 源氏察知她的心情，对她说道：“真奇怪，我在她那里打个瞌睡，竟像年轻人那样睡熟了，你也不派人来唤醒我……”

en.t: Genji sensed how she felt and said to her, "How strange it was. I only meant to doze a little there, but I slept as soundly as a young man. You might have sent someone to wake me..."
That was how he tried to comfort her, which was rather amusing in itself.
Lady Murasaki did not answer at all.

units.source_text: 源氏自觉无聊，装作想睡，就此睡着，直到日高方始起身。

en.t: Feeling awkward, Genji pretended to be sleepy and then actually fell asleep, not rising until the sun was high.
